team_recv_minus_pass_yards.note: Receiving yards are not required to equal passing yards (sacks, scrambles, laterals, two-point plays), but a systematic offset would indicate a mapping error.

scoring_reconciliation.explanation: Residual = official points - (offensive TDs*6 + 2pt*2). Remaining points come from extra points, defensive/special-teams TDs and safeties, so a residual of roughly 0-8 points per team-game is expected.
scoring_reconciliation.note: Score minus (offensive TD*6 + 2-pt) should be 0, 1 or 2 (extra point, failed extra point, safeties, defensive/return TDs). A large departure would indicate a stat-mapping error.

league_averages_per_team_game.benchmark_note: NFL league averages sit near 215-235 passing yards, 110-125 rushing yards, 20-22 receptions and 2.3-2.7 offensive TDs per team-game; a mapping error shifts these materially.

source.note: Per-game NFL Game Center JSON (official league stat feed), scraped by nflverse.

stat_mapping_source.note: Reference implementation used for the NFL stat-id -> player stat mapping (calculate_stats.R).
